'''January 2000 Lacey tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lacey, Washington on 8 January 2000. It is known from Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d168">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-lacey-washington-01082000d168/ lacey-washington-01082000], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 11 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-lacey-washington-01082000d168/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Lacey, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
